                     J U D G M E N T
KURIAN, J.
Delay condoned.
Leave granted.
The  only  question  of  law  to  be  decided  is  whether  Section
80  HHC  of  the  Income  Tax  Act,  1961  as  amended  in  2005  is
prospective in operation. It has since been settled by this Court
that the same is only prospective. 
As far as issue relating to turnover below 10 crores and above
10 crores is concerned, the same has already been answered by this
Court in the recent order dated 30.03.2015 in SLP(C) No.9273 of
2013 (C.I.T. -5 & ANR. VS. M/S. AVANI EXPORTS & ANR.) making it
clear that it applied to both categories.
In terms of the said order, these appeals are also disposed
of.
Order dated 30.03.2015, as mentioned above, shall form part of
this judgment.
...........................J.
                   (KURIAN JOSEPH)
..........................J.
                           (ROHINTON FALI NARIMAN)
NEW DELHI,
DECEMBER 02, 2016
